metadata.case_name: SHAH NISAR v. WAI KIT ENGINEERING CO LTD AND OTHERS

source: He was diagnosed with neck and back injury and admitted to Orthopaedic and Traumatology Department.

injuries.description: 3 disc protrusions at L3/4, L4/5 and L5/SI levels with mild compression of the anterior thecal sac
source: the 1st set of MRI scans taken on 7 April 2004, about 9 months after the injury, revealed 3 disc protrusions at L3/4, L4/5 and L5/SI levels with mild compression of the anterior thecal sac.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: degeneration of the discs as evidenced by spurs at L2, L4 and L5 vertebral bodies
injuries.body_part: lumbar spine / vertebral bodies L2, L4 and L5
source: spurs were found at L2, L4 and L5 vertebral bodies as shown in the report of the MRI scans by Dr. Gladys Lo dated 21 October 2004.
degeneration of the discs as evidenced by the presence of spurs at L2, L4 and L5 vertebral bodies.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: pain and tenderness along the spine, cervical, thoracic and lumbar areas
pain in his back in the lower lumbar region
no neurological deficit on both lower limbs
could not pass urine on admission and had a Foley's catheter inserted to drain out the urine
guarding and spasm over the lumbar region and mild guarding over the thoracic region
mild decrease in the range of motion of the back
pain when he walks for more than 30 to 45 minutes and when he stands for more than 45 minutes or sits for more than 2 hours
difficulty in having sexual intercourse (improved later)
unable to lift heavy objects and unable to lift his daughter who is now 2 years old

treatments_received: Foley catheter insertion to drain urine
admitted to Orthopaedic and Traumatology Department

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Because of his back injury he can no longer enjoy these [football, hockey and cricket].
He feels pain when he walks for more than 30 to 45 minutes and when he stands for more than 45 minutes or sits for more than 2 hours; required a stick for walking shortly after the accident.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Because of his back injury he had difficulty in having sexual intercourse but his condition has improved.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: He is unable to lift his daughter who is now 2 years old.
He should not be able to return to his pre-accident occupation as a steel bender.
